skill: Find the original amount after a percentage discount
learning_objective: Calculate original price when the selling price and percentage discount are known.
diagnostic_use: Suitable for diagnostic and targeted practice
common_misconceptions: Treating the sale price as the original price
Subtracting the discount from the sale price
ai_coaching_note: Ask the student what percentage of the original price remains after the discount.
recommended_next_action: Assign reverse percentage mini-lesson if missed.
